name: Orthofix Medical Inc.
summary: Orthofix Medical Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a medical technology company in the United States, Italy, the United Kingdom, France, Germany, Brazil, and internationally. It operates through two segments, Global Spine and Global Limb Reconstruction.
